title: Acceptance harness for private VPC deploys — automated smoke and model-load validations
creator: Marco Chen
description: Goal: Provide a lightweight, automated acceptance harness that runs immediately after Terraform/Ansible finishes provisioning a Private VPC deployment, validating API readiness, running a minimal model-load test, and executing smoke tests against critical endpoints. This harness must be runnable as part of CI or via a 'post_apply' Terraform hook and should return a deterministic success/failure code so automation can gate rollouts or trigger rollback policies.
acceptance_criteria: Post-deploy step runs automatically when 'apply' completes in the PrivateDeploy CI pipeline or can be invoked manually via ./scripts/post_deploy_check.sh
API readiness probe returns HTTP 200 and JSON with 'status: ready' within 2 minutes of service start
Model-load test (single-worker) successfully loads target model weights and completes a 16-token generation with p95 latency < 1200ms on dedicated test instance configuration
Smoke tests hit chat/generate/embeddings endpoints and validate response schema + confidence heuristics
Harness emits metrics with the agreed naming convention: redwood.api.ready, redwood.model.load.success, redwood.model.latency.p95_ms, redwood.inference.error_rate
Failure cases produce actionable logs and a link to the failing run; automation can mark deployment as FAILED and trigger fallback policy
Test run surface-level resource checks (GPU memory >= model_min_memory, disk space > 10 GB, KV-cache warmup observed)
implementation_notes: Primary approach: add an optional Terraform null_resource with a local-exec provisioner that calls the post-deploy test runner container (docker image: redwood/post-deploy-check:202603). For on-prem customers where local-exec isn't viable, support an AWS SSM run-command / k8s Job variant.

Runner responsibilities: 1) API readiness polling against management endpoint (https://{{ingress}}/healthz and /api/v1/status), 2) perform model load via the /admin/load-model endpoint with a controlled timeout, 3) run a short inference job using a deterministic prompt and validate output schema, 4) emit metrics to CloudWatch/Datadog and write a summary JSON to the Terraform artifact path

Model-load specifics: attempt loading the pinned model version from the deployment manifest, wait up to 90s for warmup, then invoke a 16-token generation on a small batch (batch_size=1) to validate KV cache behavior. Record load success/failure and p50/p95 latencies

Retries/backoff: On transient failures, retry readiness check up to 5 times with exponential backoff starting at 3s. If model-load times out, capture logs and mark as failed. CI orchestration may decide to retry entire 'apply' up to 2 times before rollback

Observability integration: Add a dedicated dashboard tile showing last post-deploy run, success rate, p95 latency, and errors. Provide a run link that points to the job logs in the deployment's S3/Log bucket

Security: post-deploy runner must use short-lived tokens created by the deployment (service account with scoped permissions). Avoid storing long-term secrets in the harness. Marked security_review_required=true
API contract checks: validate required fields for structured output (message/choices/metadata) and ensure function/tool-calling controls are present when enabled

Failure handling: if harness fails and deployment is Dedicated/Private with automatic rollbacks enabled, call the Control Plane API to revert to the prior model variant or flip traffic to the hosted fallback. Otherwise, report and leave deployment paused for manual triage
runbook_snippets: Terraform hook example: resource "null_resource" "post_deploy_check" { provisioner "local-exec" { command = "./scripts/post_deploy_check.sh --endpoint ${self.triggers.endpoint} --report ${path.module}/postdeploy.json" } triggers = { endpoint = aws_lb.my.lb_dns_name } }
Kubernetes variant: kubectl -n redwood run post-deploy-check --image=redwood/post-deploy-check:202603 --restart=Never -- ./run-check --endpoint https://private-deploy.svc.cluster.local
Expected quick health response: curl -fsS -m 5 https://{{endpoint}}/api/v1/status | jq -r .status  # should print 'ready'
comments: 2026-03-01 Marco Chen: Created ticket and sketched acceptance criteria. Suggested Terraform local-exec + k8s Job fallback. Punted SSM variant for later if customers need it.

2026-03-03 Priya Patel: Ran manual prototype in staging. Observed model-load taking 40-70s depending on quantization. Will add a explicit 'model_min_memory' check before attempting load to fail fast on undersized nodes.

2026-03-05 Elena Gomez (SRE): Reviewed approach. Requested that the harness emit a deterministic artifact (postdeploy.json) to the deployment bucket with timestamps and full logs for auditability. Also asked for metrics tag 'deployment_id' and 'cluster_id'.
2026-03-07 Priya Patel: Updated runner to include exponential backoff and 90s model-load timeout. Pushed proof-of-concept image redwood/post-deploy-check:202603 and opened PR #1423. Linked it below.

2026-03-10 Marco Chen: Integration test in CI passed for AWS VPC flow. Noted one flaky failure where KV cache warmup took >90s on p4d-sim machines; opened ENG-4852 to investigate kernel selection and paging behavior.
